text:
ellie: capturing follow-ups from the postmortem on last week's KV-cache OOMs. Objective: short fixes to avoid immediate recurrence + owners for compaction-aware eviction RFC.

yusuf: ack. I can own the hotfix for a soft pinned cap + emergency eviction behind a flag. Target canary Thu 02:00 UTC.

mica: I'll own profiling + small repro harness to produce allocation timelines and flamegraphs. ETA: Wed EOD.

ellie: we also need to address the recurring pattern: fragmentation spikes right after background compaction windows which delays reclamation. Proposal: make eviction heuristics compaction-aware and stagger compactions across shards.

yusuf: hotfix plan: add kv.max_pinned_per_shard=40 (default behind flag) and kv.emergency_evict=true. Emergency evict will prefer oldest pinned entries (non-destructive) and emit metric kv.emergency_evictions. PR #5330.

mica: repro (local):
```
$ ./tools/kv-stress --shards 4 --concurrency 220 --batch-size 128 --duration 90s --target http://localhost:8080/prefetch
```

mica: profiling shows 24-36MB pinned buffers during BatchReader::drain that linger after response completion; adding pin/unpin spans and a test that asserts unpin within request teardown.

ellie: QA: can we run a mem-stress smoke on canary before full rollout? @ci-bot please schedule 30m test and fail build on pinned growth > 80MB in 5m.

ci-bot: scheduled job mem-canary-1999999 for Thu 01:20 UTC against canary. Results to /ci/reports/mem-canary-1999999.

yusuf: rollout plan: land behind flag -> enable in canary -> 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% if no regressions. Will include rollback toggle and oncall playbook in PR.

miriam: SGTM. Mica, please add kv.fragmentation_pct to dashboards and an alert: fragmentation_pct > 30 for 10m. Also capture compaction windows as an annotation.

mica: will add dashboard panel + alert. Also adding a long-term task: RFC for compaction-aware eviction heuristics (prefer ranges impacted by compaction pauses) and staggering compaction schedule per shard. Owner: mica. Draft due next Fri.

ellie: action summary (owners + ETA):
- yusuf: soft cap + emergency_evict hotfix (PR #5330) -> canary Thu 02:00 UTC
- mica: repro & flamegraph -> Wed EOD; dashboards + alert -> Wed EOD; RFC draft -> next Fri
- ellie: runbook update + exec summary for stakeholders -> PR opened Thu morning

yusuf: adding CI regression that fails if pinned bytes increase > 80MB in 5m during synthetic workload. PR #5332.

mica: recurring pattern note: compaction at ~03:00 UTC aligns with two OOMs. Stagger compactions across shards in infra chore. I'll ping infra and add chore to backlog.

ellie: please post PR links and CI results to this thread. We'll reconvene after canary results and decide whether to expand rollout. If emergency_evict flips more than 3x/hour, we escalate to SEV.

yusuf: ack. PRs in flight: #5330 (guardrail), #5332 (CI regression).

mica: ack. I'll upload flamegraphs and the repro dataset when ready.

ellie: thanks team — keeping this tight should reduce recurrence risk.
